title: Concept: PostgreSQL password hashing set to MD5 in postgres — review required
description: In postgres, the cluster still hashes role passwords with MD5. The scheme is unsalted per role and fast to evaluate, so an offline copy of the catalog is crackable at billions of candidates per second on commodity hardware. PostgreSQL has supported SCRAM-SHA-256 for years, so the setting is almost always stale rather than required.
applicability: postgres database clusters managed through configuration files.
risk: Credential recovery from a stolen catalog; MEDIUM severity.
